in_sanskrit.name: Biju
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Powerful, Blessed
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Biju एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Biju is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'bij', meaning seed or origin. In Hindu mythology, Biju is considered a powerful and blessed name for a boy. It symbolizes the potential for growth and success, much like a seed that is planted and nurtured.
